about: Action-battle leader abilities (StatueInfo.leaderAbilityInfo, docs/research/30-action-battle.md §7): one entry per statue whose wiki leader ability has at least one line the action battle reads. The server sends {abilityId, abilityLevel, abilityName, abilityParamList, isInit true} with the params inline (paramListLv1_0..7 / paramListLv10_0..7 from lv1 / lv10). Units: p0 per mille (N% x 10, xX as (X-1) x 1000, flat values as they are, SP uses as the count); p1 the tribe or StatueType of a target; p2 seconds x 10, an HP threshold per mille or the holder tribe. "left" lists the hold categories of the lines not served. Built by tools/content/build_action_abilities.py.
